annotations.title: AI terms of service and privacy policy analyzer

description: AI terms of service and privacy policy analyzer — Reads a terms of service or privacy policy (url= of the page, or text= up to 24,000 characters) and returns a plain-English summary, an A-E fairness grade with score and verdict, and red flags (severity high/medium/low, why it matters, and a supporting quote checked word-for-word against the text). Also extracts data collected, data sharing, user rights actually granted, auto-renewal, cancellation, arbitration and class-action waiver (with opt-out), governing law, liability cap, the license taken over user content, AI-training use and how terms can change, plus offline keyword signals as a cross-check. For agents deciding whether to sign up for, buy from or integrate with a service. Not legal advice. Price: $0.012 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_tos_summary
